context: Kenji and Ren have a business meeting about Ren's students.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: レン君、相談、いいですか？
lines.en: Ren-kun, do you have a moment? I'd like to ask your advice.
lines.style: Warm, respectful approach. Soft knock on the door of the request. Not demanding — asking permission first. Steady, genuine tone underneath the formal courtesy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Immediate, open response. No hesitation. Quiet attentiveness — the kind that says 'I'm here, really listening.' Gentle and ready.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お前の生徒、今年、五人、来てほしい。
lines.en: I was hoping to bring five of your students in this year. If that works.
lines.style: Careful framing — this matters, and he knows Ren will understand why. Not a demand but a request. Slight lean forward in the voice, hopeful but not presuming.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Genuine surprise and pleasure. The words come quickly, a small lift in his voice. Not performed — real delight at being trusted with this.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お前の指導、信頼してる。
lines.style: Deliberate and quiet. Each word carries weight. Not flattery — this is earned trust being named aloud. A moment of vulnerability in the sincerity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感謝、一緒に、頑張ります。
lines.en: Thank you. We'll do our best together.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. The 'together' lands softly — he's not carrying this alone and he hears that. Steady, grateful, ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Closing note of genuine trust. Slightly slower tempo. The repetition of 'truly' isn't doubling down — it's him letting the weight of his confidence settle between them.
